statement: 安装使用不可变版本目录和提交记录。文件完整落盘并完成标记后，才能切换有效版本；任意阶段断电或进程退出，都能恢复为旧版可用或新版本待恢复。

rules.text: 候选安装经过创建、展开、验证、目录发布、DB 激活和清理的持久提交日志。
READY 记录绑定清单摘要和校验结果，文件落盘后同卷 rename，再事务更新 active_release。
文件系统与数据库不构成一个原子事务，重启按日志和目录对账完成或回滚。
旧版本到新版本健康与回退条件成立后才回收，不能凭 UI 显示完成就删唯一可用版。
rules.qualification: Conservative retention: different installed versions are never automatically GC'd. This does not accept the adjacent UPD health/rollback feature.

enforcement.property: Worker awaits initialization and serializes install against recovery/runtime modification
All chunk hashes, full archive hash and extracted file hashes checked before READY

Sibling staging/final paths, same-release different-manifest refusal, transactional active pointer and row publication
Old different release directories retained; prior saves backed up before compatible upgrade
Initialization exposes UI only after metadata reconciliation; launch preflight rechecks integrity metadata/signature/runtime

findings.title: VERIFIED omits nested and new ancestor directory durability barriers
findings.spec_claim: VERIFIED means files, READY and directories are durable before publication; file/parent directory synchronization failures must be reported.
findings.code_behavior: The extractor fsyncs each file and the staging root, but not nested file-parent directories or all newly created ancestor links. The post-rename sync covers only the versions directory. safeChild performs no synchronization.
preconditions: A package has nested files such as RomFS/a/b/data.bin, or installation/journal ancestor directories are newly created.
The Android filesystem does not provide stronger implicit directory durability than the operations request.
reproducer: After DIRECTORY_PUBLISHED, model power loss while retaining completed explicit sync writes but dropping nested directory-entry writes that received no directory fsync.
On restart observe a published candidate whose declared nested name is missing, or a newly created ancestor link absent despite its lower-level directory having been synced.
findings.consequence: Power-loss durability is not established for the claimed VERIFIED/activated directory; an invalid published candidate can additionally trigger F02.
findings.limitation: Actual loss on the target Android filesystem was not executed or established. The missing required sync operations are source-confirmed.
findings.repair_direction: Synchronize extracted directories bottom-up and synchronize newly created ancestor names through their parents before publishing the corresponding durable phase.

findings.title: Invalid published journal aborts initialization and prevents use of retained valid releases
findings.spec_claim: Restart must complete or roll back using the journal/directory evidence, preserving old usable releases and exposing repair/recovery for inconsistent candidates.
findings.code_behavior: recover uses throwing requirements and activate without per-journal compensation. One invalid marker/index/file aborts before general storage reconciliation, leaves ready false and keeps the same journal. The only UI is retrying the same recovery; old and unrelated valid games cannot launch.
preconditions: A valid previous active release exists.
A DIRECTORY_PUBLISHED journal remains after interruption and the candidate has a missing critical file or invalid marker/index.
reproducer: Keep v1 valid and active; install v2 and terminate after DIRECTORY_PUBLISHED before DB activation.
Apply AC-P05's critical-file deletion fault to one v2 resource while preserving its marker/index, or produce the equivalent missing entry through F01.
Restart: metadata validation fails in activate, initialize rethrows, ready remains false and the journal remains.
Retry recovery: it reaches the same immutable failing state; v1 and other valid games remain behind the global gate.
findings.consequence: A single interrupted/corrupt candidate denies the whole usable library until intervention outside the product; the old copy is physically retained but unusable.
findings.prior_fix_distinction: e6ee168's registered-install reconciliation works when invoked. This journal recovery throws before that new reconciler can run.
findings.repair_direction: Handle each candidate independently, retain its recovery ownership/error, preserve or restore a verified previous-active reference and expose repair without globally withholding unrelated valid installs.

findings.title: Recovery completes installation but permanently loses the download-cleanup obligation
findings.spec_claim: The durable CLEANED phase means unreferenced downloads/temporaries have been cleaned and replay can finish idempotently.
findings.code_behavior: Normal install writes CLEANED/removes its journal before the worker deletes the archive directory. Recovery activates, marks transfer completed and deletes the journal without ever cleaning that directory. Completed transfers are skipped by worker/reconciler, and maintenance only trims session logs.
preconditions: An interrupted installation is recovered from a valid published directory, or ordinary cleanup is interrupted/fails after the transfer becomes completed.
reproducer: Finish archive download and terminate after the DIRECTORY_PUBLISHED journal write.
Restart with valid candidate data; recovery successfully activates and marks the transfer completed.
Observe transfers/<id>/archive.zip.partial and both index files still present after the journal is removed.
Repeat startup or run maintenance: neither schedules cleanup of the completed transfer's directory.
findings.consequence: Full archives, potentially many GiB per recovered update, remain indefinitely and accumulate storage that can block later installs.
findings.repair_direction: Persist/reconstruct an idempotent cleanup obligation, check deletion outcomes and synchronize removal before declaring CLEANED. Keep completed history independent of archive existence.
